title: Red Velvet Cream Cheese Swirl Cake
hookLine: Buttermilk cocoa velvet crumb crowned with tangy whipped cream cheese frosting.

items.name: Whipped cream cheese + butter + powdered sugar frosting

steps.title: Preheat Oven & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line your baking pan with parchment paper, leaving a slight overhang for effortless lifting. Measure out {flour_rv} and {bmilk_rv} so everything is ready and at room temperature for a silky, lump-free batter.

steps.title: Mix Velvet Batter & Bake 28m
steps.instructionTemplate: Whisk {bmilk_rv} and fold into {flour_rv} with 1 cup sugar and red food gel. Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 28 minutes. Line your baking pan with parchment paper or grease lightly, and make sure {flour_rv} and {bmilk_rv} are measured and at room temperature so they blend smoothly.

steps.title: Swirl Cream Cheese Frosting
steps.instructionTemplate: Once cool, generously swirl {frost_rv} over every layer. Let Red Velvet Cream Cheese Swirl Cake cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 10 portions, then garnish and serve.
steps.creatorSecret: Wait until the sponge feels cool to the touch before frosting so your glaze or cream stays thick and glossy.

steps.title: Cool Completely, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer Red Velvet Cream Cheese Swirl Cake to a wire cooling rack and let it cool for 15–20 minutes so the interior sets cleanly without crumbling. Lift out using the parchment overhang, garnish as desired, and slice into 10 portions.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 43 mins.
